newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan imprisons official for life for corruption.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan imprisons official for life for corruption.

text.p: A Taiwan county magistrate has been sentenced to life in prison for corruption, a court spokesman said on Monday.

Wu Tse-yuan, magistrate of southern Pingtung County, was convicted of receiving bribes from construction contractors when he was head of the Taiwan provincial government's city planning and development department, the spokesman said by telephone.
The court said Wu had received some T$200 million in illegal profits.
"Wu Tse-yuan was a senior official...but his behaviour has seriously eroded the nation's foundation and damaged the government's reputation," a judge told reporters.
Taiwan has declared a crackdown on corruption after a series of scandals surfaced in the wake of democratic reforms begun in the late 1980s.
